inspiration: Combat and chat UI is built as small scene units (a chat line, a bubble, a message line, a model frame). A clean component split to copy in our own HUD style.
Frames are authored as layout data and converted to scenes by a script (convert.py). Keep our layout as data and generate HUD scenes, with our own coordinates and art.
Benchmark pages compare two clients on login, world load and idle CPU. Good template for a performance table on our own builds.
A translation layer keeps keys separate from text and falls back to English for missing lines. Copy this for our localisation.
The login and character creation screens are shown as a small set of screenshots per client. Good showcase pattern. The screenshots have no origin statement in the files, so they are not for reuse.
Shader and resource files are split from scenes (gdshader and tres). Good split for our material and rim-light work.
